title: AttributeValue
description: One {attribute_uri, value} pair carried by a MetricObservation. Modelled as a list of structured pairs rather than a map so attribute ordering and emitter behaviour are stable.

attribute_uri.description: The URI of the MetricAttribute whose value this AttributeValue carries.

attribute_value.description: The literal value of an attribute on an observation, series, or dataset. Typed as string because attribute values are heterogeneous (status codes, integer counts, free text); cast at emission time against the attribute's declared value_range.
